evidence.quoted_text: any(compatible(item[key], spec) for item in matches),
evidence.reason: At line 80, the test uses any(...) so a manifest type mismatch is masked whenever at least one fixture item of that kind has a compatible value. Since matches is already asserted nonempty, all(...) is the minimal correct check and still permits union specifications. The same defect exists at lines 102 and 111 for event/work values.
